headline: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump pushed for his return, sparking bipartisan backlash over national security concerns, as War on the Rocks warned AI poses the biggest challenge to civil-military relations since the nuclear bomb.

points.text: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO after President Trump pushed for his return, with allies arguing he was 'too big to fail'; the move sparked bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill, with Senate Minority Leader Schumer warning Congress is coming for answers on national security risks.
CSET argued the 'cyber apocalypse' should be judged by data, not headlines, finding that recent AI advances are enabling cyberattackers more than defenders.
War on the Rocks warned that AI poses the greatest challenge to American civil-military relations since the advent of the nuclear bomb.
AI data centers' surging energy demand added another complication to already-chaotic UN climate talks.
AI Policy Bulletin argued the UK should back a 'Bellingcat for AI incidents' to help independent researchers find AI incidents companies haven't disclosed.
The ITU's AI for Good discussed building shared global standards for brain-computer interfaces.
